method.equation: angle_next = angle_current + intercept + feature_vector @ coefficients; prediction errors wrapped to [-180,180).
method.model: Three ridge linear regressions, one per Euler-angle increment. Coefficients shared by all aircraft; no aircraft or match identifiers used as features.
method.history: Angles at n,n-1,n-2 encoded as two wrapped increments and sin/cos of current angles.
method.velocity: vn,ve,vu and TAS at n plus two backward differences, using n,n-1,n-2 only.
method.split: Outer leave-one-match-out; alpha per output chosen by inner leave-one-training-match-out. Scaling/intercept fitted using training data only.
method.final_model: Full-data models are saved for reuse. All prediction plots and headline errors use outer held-out predictions, not full-data models.
method.baseline: Persistence and constant-rate baseline; history-only ridge has the same nested validation to assess added velocity information.
method.limitations: Only three matches, two share ic100601. Target action at n is not included. One-step conditional prediction, not autonomous rollout or physical dynamics identification.
method.angle_convention: Assume yaw clockwise from North, positive pitch upward. README does not fully specify Euler conventions. Pitch observed stays away from +/-90 degrees.
method.direction: Forward axis = (cos(pitch)cos(yaw), cos(pitch)sin(yaw), sin(pitch)) in NEU. Roll does not change this forward axis.
method.position: WGS84 geodetic latitude and ellipsoidal altitude assumed, converted to ECEF; displacement and midpoint velocity projected to NEU at n.
method.midpoint: (v_ECEF[n]+v_ECEF[n+1])/2 only for direction diagnostics. Never used in prediction features.
method.nose_warning: Nose/velocity mismatch is not labelled aerodynamic angle of attack or sideslip: wind and air-relative vector are not established.
method.filter: Same four consecutive alive samples per aircraft as position fit. No residual-based exclusions.
